experimental_unit: one fixed query with its fixed ordered 50-candidate pool scored end-to-end by one reranker execution route (protocol section 3)

controlled_variables.sigmoid_normalisation: shared production _sigmoid applied once (ONNX raw logits; torch Identity activation then _sigmoid)
controlled_variables.machine_policy: same machine, power source and background-load policy (protocol section 5); no vector DB, embedding, BM25 or network access inside measured inference

abort_criteria: requested execution route differs from the effective one observed on the production reranker (providers[0] mismatch, torch device prefix mismatch, or production graceful fallback with last_failure_reason set)
model or tokenizer differs between cells
model download occurs inside the measured region (children run with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
thermal/power event or process failure prevents the declared repetitions from completing -> repetition/cell incomplete, not slow

primary_contrasts.name: H1_device_parity
primary_contrasts.practical_gate: 100% ranking equality and max abs per-candidate score delta <= 1e-4 across every query and measured pass

primary_contrasts.name: H4_backend_attribution
primary_contrasts.practical_gate: every ONNX-vs-Torch ranking disagreement is cross-checked against torch_cpu-vs-torch_mps before attribution

primary_contrasts.name: H5_manifest_truth
primary_contrasts.practical_gate: every completed cell proves its effective device/provider before timing began
